tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. The brand's primary identity surface in dark; the product UI's base in light.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Secondary panel surface: sidebar chrome, tiles, edition cards.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Tertiary fill: alternating section background in dark marketing pages, user-message bubble background in the light product UI.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders, dividers, hairlines.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text.

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subheads, body copy that isn't the primary read.

tokens.name: text-dimmer
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: section labels, timestamps, placeholder text. Opacity chosen as the lowest that still holds 4.5:1 on bg, surface and surface-alt in each theme, measured from OKLCH lightness (luminance = L³, WCAG ratio; see guidelines/brand-guidelines.md, “Measuring contrast”). (Was 0.40 / 0.42, which measured 2.8:1 and 3.5:1.)

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Fixed dark neutral, same value in both themes. Used specifically as the text/icon colour on top of the accent fill — see the contrast rule below.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary brand accent. Buttons, active states, the brand mark. Same value in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Accent hover state: lighter on dark surfaces, darker on light surfaces, following normal contrast direction for each.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: The accent used AS TEXT: links and other orange text on bg, surface or surface-alt. The accent itself (#FA5B35) measures 2.6–2.9:1 as text on light surfaces, so the light theme uses the same 34.5° hue at a lower lightness (OKLCH 0.538 0.191 34.5°), holding 4.5:1 on all three light surfaces, measured from OKLCH lightness (luminance = L³, WCAG ratio; see guidelines/brand-guidelines.md, “Measuring contrast”). On dark surfaces the accent itself holds 4.8:1 or more, so the dark value is the accent. Fills (buttons, the mark) keep using accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icon colour on any accent-filled surface (buttons, badges). ALWAYS ink, never white or text — white-on-accent measures 2.91:1 against orange and 1.93:1 against teal, measured from OKLCH lightness (luminance = L³, WCAG ratio; see guidelines/brand-guidelines.md, “Measuring contrast”), both WCAG failures. This is the system's one non-negotiable contrast rule.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Secondary accent. Decorative use only: borders, icon fills on dark backgrounds, low-opacity washes. Reads as a distinct 'verified / system-level' signal, separate from accent's 'primary action' role.

tokens.name: teal-ink
tokens.usage: Teal used AS TEXT OR AN ICON STROKE where contrast matters (citation labels, the air-gapped status pill). Darkened in the light theme on purpose: plain teal at 79% lightness fails contrast on a white background, so this token carries the same semantic role (the teal/citation signal) at a value that holds 4.5:1 on bg, surface, surface-alt and the pill's own teal wash in each theme, measured from OKLCH lightness (luminance = L³, WCAG ratio; see guidelines/brand-guidelines.md, “Measuring contrast”). Same ~188° hue as teal; only lightness and chroma differ. Light value OKLCH 0.537 0.093 188° (was #0F8A82, which measured 3.9:1 on surface-alt and 4.1:1 on the pill wash).

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Floating overlay panels such as the cookie banner and its preferences dialog. Dark in both themes by design, so the banner looks the same wherever it appears.

tokens.name: control-off
tokens.usage: A switch track in its off state, and the knob of a read-only switch. Holds the 3:1 non-text contrast for UI components against surface-overlay, the dark bg and the light bg/surface (measured from OKLCH lightness (luminance = L³, WCAG ratio; see guidelines/brand-guidelines.md, “Measuring contrast”)). OKLCH 0.588 0.017 248°, the same blue-grey as before, lighter (was #4A525A, which measured 2.1:1 on surface-overlay).

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Hero and page headlines. Scales with clamp(34px, 5.4vw, 54px) on the live site; 48px is the desktop reference size.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles, chat/conversation titles, component labels.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary body text, chat messages, card copy.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels and eyebrow text. Set in uppercase in use (not a formal property here).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The sūveryn wordmark. IBM Plex Mono is reserved for this ONE use — never body copy, never UI labels. This was a deliberate switch from JetBrains Mono, chosen for its wider character spacing at small sizes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between small adjacent elements (nav icon rows, chip padding).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Standard inline gaps, chip horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Component internal padding (buttons, inputs, message bubbles).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, section-internal spacing.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Spacing between stacked components.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile, gaps between major blocks.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Grid gutters between hero/problem columns on narrow layouts.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Grid gutters between columns at full width.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding (hero, problem, editions).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, small interactive controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, dropdown-style surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Larger panels, the chat-interface visual card, message bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, pill buttons, avatars, the composer input.
